overview: An AI-powered web app that analyzes text for hallucinations and trustworthiness. Users paste AI-generated content and get a Trust Score, Hallucination Risk level, highlighted suspicious sentences, confidence charts, and fake citation detection — all powered by NLP via external AI services.
features: Hallucination Risk badge — Low, Medium, or High
Suspicious sentence highlighting with per-sentence confidence
Confidence bar chart and risk distribution pie chart
Explainability tooltips for all key metrics
Sample test examples with one-click loading
